# Plan

Do eIF3d-promoted mRNAs carry more m6A sites than other expressed mRNAs, in the 5'UTR, the
CDS or the 3'UTR? Answered with cumulative distribution (CDF) plots and no model.

**Data.** Mukhopadhyay, Amodeo & Lee 2023, *Mol Cell* 83:3303 ("eIF3d controls the persistent
integrated stress response"), Table S3 = `accessories/NIHMS1925721-supplement-4_ISR.xlsx`.
m6A-eCLIP in **HEK293T**, not MDA-MB-231: the paper has no 231 data. 6,589 sites, one row per
site, with the paper's region call (`5utr` / `cds` / `3utr` / `ncRNA`) and the methylation level
at that site (reads at the site per million mapped reads) in three lines: untreated WT eIF3d,
WT + thapsigargin (Tg, chronic ER stress) and phosphomimetic ("DD") eIF3d + Tg.

**Decisions**

- **Why no model.** Only ~15% of the feature matrix's genes appear in Table S3, and the
  regression drops any feature more than half missing, so the features would never have entered
  the forest. Distributions over the genes that *are* in the table answer the question directly.
- **Missing vs zero.** A gene in Table S3 gets a count in every region, 0 where it has no site
  there. A gene not in Table S3 is **NA**, not 0: absence can mean "not expressed in HEK293T",
  which says nothing about methylation. So every CDF is drawn over genes in the table only.
  Whether targets are *in* the table at all is reported separately (section 4), because that
  mostly measures HEK expression.
- **Sites map to genes, not to our transcripts.** The column Table S3 calls `ensembl_gene_id`
  holds versioned **transcript** IDs. They are mapped to genes through GENCODE v49, with gene
  symbol as a fallback for IDs v49 no longer carries. HEK isoforms are not our 231 isoforms,
  so the paper's own region call is kept rather than re-assigned onto our transcripts.
- **ncRNA sites are excluded from the counts** (they include 773 mitochondrial sites), but a gene
  whose only sites are ncRNA is still *in the table*, so it gets 0 in all three regions.
- **Counts and density.** Raw counts rise with region length, and CDS length is the strongest
  single feature separating eIF3d targets, so a count difference could be length alone. Each
  region is therefore also shown as **sites per kb** of that region. The length is that of the
  paper's transcript (GENCODE v49), taking the gene's transcript with the most sites.
- **Target set** = te_lfc > `r params$lfc_min` and te_padj < `r params$padj_max` in each contrast,
  computed from the `translation_categories_*` file rather than a gene-set CSV, because no CSV
  exists for normoxia 1+4hr. For hypoxia 1hr this is asserted to reproduce
  `hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv`. MDA-MB-231 normoxia is the 1+4hr time-regressed
  contrast, never plain 1hr.
- **Comparator** = every other gene DESeq2 tested in that contrast (non-NA te_padj): a typical
  expressed mRNA, not the screened negative-control set (which is selected for having no effect).
- **This render:** site set = `r params$site_set`.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse); library(here); library(GenomicFeatures); library(AnnotationDbi)
})
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
dir.create(here("plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
kd_colors <- c("si3d" = "#E69F00")
stopifnot("site_set must be all or regulated" = params$site_set %in% c("all", "regulated"))
```

# 1. Load Table S3 and reproduce the paper

```{r load_sites}
s3 <- readxl::read_excel(here("accessories", "NIHMS1925721-supplement-4_ISR.xlsx"))
expected_cols <- c("chr", "m6A_site", "ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "strand", "location",
                   "WT_eIF3d (avg TPM)", "WT_TG_eIF3d (avg TPM)", "DD_TG_eIF3d (avg TPM)")
stopifnot("Table S3 columns changed" = identical(names(s3), expected_cols))
sites <- s3 %>%
  dplyr::rename(tx_versioned = ensembl_gene_id, symbol_s3 = hgnc_symbol,
                wt = `WT_eIF3d (avg TPM)`, wt_tg = `WT_TG_eIF3d (avg TPM)`,
                dd_tg = `DD_TG_eIF3d (avg TPM)`) %>%
  mutate(tx = sub("\\..*", "", tx_versioned))

# Range checks: methylation levels are non-negative and finite; regions are the four the paper uses.
stopifnot(
  "paper reports 6,590 sites; S3 should hold 6,589-6,590 rows" = between(nrow(sites), 6589, 6590),
  "methylation level negative or non-finite" =
    all(is.finite(c(sites$wt, sites$wt_tg, sites$dd_tg)) & c(sites$wt, sites$wt_tg, sites$dd_tg) >= 0),
  "unexpected region label" = all(sites$location %in% c("5utr", "cds", "3utr", "ncRNA")),
  "ID column is not transcript IDs" = all(str_starts(sites$tx, "ENST"))
)

# The paper's ISR/eIF3d-regulated site (Fig. 4C legend): >= 1.5-fold more methylation in BOTH
# untreated WT and Tg-treated DD than in Tg-treated WT. A tiny pseudocount keeps sites that are
# 0 in WT+Tg (fully demethylated) in the regulated set instead of dividing by zero.
pc <- 0.01
sites <- sites %>%
  mutate(regulated = (wt + pc) / (wt_tg + pc) >= 1.5 & (dd_tg + pc) / (wt_tg + pc) >= 1.5)
```

Two published results this table must reproduce before anything is joined to it.

```{r reproduce_paper}
# Fig. 4C: regulated sites are "strikingly enriched" in the 5'UTR relative to unregulated ones.
utr5_share <- sites %>% filter(location != "ncRNA") %>%
  group_by(regulated) %>% summarise(n = n(), utr5_share = mean(location == "5utr"))
print(utr5_share)
sh_reg   <- utr5_share$utr5_share[utr5_share$regulated]
sh_unreg <- utr5_share$utr5_share[!utr5_share$regulated]
cat(sprintf("5'UTR share of mRNA sites: regulated %.1f%% vs unregulated %.1f%% (%.1f-fold)\n",
            100 * sh_reg, 100 * sh_unreg, sh_reg / sh_unreg))
stopifnot("Fig. 4C 5'UTR enrichment of regulated sites not reproduced" = sh_reg / sh_unreg > 2)

# Text + Fig. 4F: "three m6A sites in ATF4, including one in the 5' UTR ... that undergoes
# ISR/eIF3d-dependent demethylation".
atf4 <- sites %>% filter(symbol_s3 == "ATF4")
print(atf4 %>% dplyr::select(location, wt, wt_tg, dd_tg, regulated))
stopifnot(
  "ATF4 should carry three sites" = nrow(atf4) == 3,
  "ATF4's 5'UTR site should be the regulated one" =
    identical(atf4$regulated[atf4$location == "5utr"], TRUE) && !any(atf4$regulated[atf4$location != "5utr"])
)
```

**Not reproduced, and recorded rather than forced:** the text gives 5,061 / 3,001 / 1,575 sites
in DD + Tg / untreated WT / WT + Tg. No cutoff on these columns returns those numbers (level
> 0 gives 6,515 / 6,150 / 5,679), so the per-condition site calls are not recoverable from
Table S3. GEO GSE236188 deposits per-condition site files (`GSE236188_*_m6A_sites.txt.gz`) that
probably hold them. This notebook only uses which sites exist and where, so it does not depend
on that call.

# 2. Map sites to genes

```{r map_genes}
txdb <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
txlen <- transcriptLengths(txdb, with.cds_len = TRUE, with.utr5_len = TRUE, with.utr3_len = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(tx = sub("\\..*", "", tx_name), gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id),
            utr5_len, cds_len, utr3_len)
stopifnot("txdb transcript IDs not unique" = !any(duplicated(txlen$tx)))

# Fallback: symbol -> gene, only for symbols that name exactly one gene in the v49 annotation.
anno <- read_tsv(here("accessories", "human", "gene_anno_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv"),
                 col_names = c("gene_id", "symbol", "biotype", "species", "release"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(species == "human") %>% distinct(gene_id, symbol) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>% filter(n_distinct(gene_id_clean) == 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  distinct(symbol, gene_id_clean)

sites <- sites %>%
  left_join(txlen, by = "tx") %>%
  mutate(map = if_else(is.na(gene_id_clean), "symbol", "transcript"),
         gene_id_clean = coalesce(gene_id_clean, anno$gene_id_clean[match(symbol_s3, anno$symbol)]))
print(dplyr::count(sites, map, mapped = !is.na(gene_id_clean)))
stopifnot("more than 2% of sites unmapped" = mean(is.na(sites$gene_id_clean)) < 0.02)
sites <- sites %>% filter(!is.na(gene_id_clean))

# Restrict to the chosen site set AFTER deciding which genes are in the table: a gene with only
# unregulated sites is still in the table (count 0 regulated), not missing.
genes_in_table <- unique(sites$gene_id_clean)
counted <- sites %>% filter(location != "ncRNA", params$site_set == "all" | regulated)

# Per gene and region: number of sites, and that region's length on the gene's most-sited
# transcript (sites mapped by symbol carry no length and do not choose it).
rep_tx <- sites %>% filter(!is.na(cds_len) | !is.na(utr5_len)) %>%
  dplyr::count(gene_id_clean, tx, utr5_len, cds_len, utr3_len, name = "n_sites") %>%
  arrange(gene_id_clean, desc(n_sites), tx) %>% distinct(gene_id_clean, .keep_all = TRUE)

region_labs <- c(utr5 = "5'UTR", cds = "CDS", utr3 = "3'UTR")
m6a <- expand_grid(gene_id_clean = genes_in_table, region = names(region_labs)) %>%
  left_join(counted %>% mutate(region = recode(location, `5utr` = "utr5", `3utr` = "utr3")) %>%
              dplyr::count(gene_id_clean, region, name = "n_sites"),
            by = c("gene_id_clean", "region")) %>%
  mutate(n_sites = replace_na(n_sites, 0L)) %>%
  left_join(rep_tx %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, utr5 = utr5_len, cds = cds_len, utr3 = utr3_len) %>%
              pivot_longer(-gene_id_clean, names_to = "region", values_to = "region_len"),
            by = c("gene_id_clean", "region")) %>%
  mutate(sites_per_kb = if_else(!is.na(region_len) & region_len > 0, n_sites / (region_len / 1000), NA_real_))

stopifnot(
  "site counts must be non-negative integers" = all(m6a$n_sites >= 0 & m6a$n_sites == round(m6a$n_sites)),
  "density must be finite and non-negative" = all(is.finite(m6a$sites_per_kb[!is.na(m6a$sites_per_kb)]) &
                                                    m6a$sites_per_kb[!is.na(m6a$sites_per_kb)] >= 0),
  "one row per gene x region" = !any(duplicated(m6a[, c("gene_id_clean", "region")])),
  "counted sites lost in aggregation" = sum(m6a$n_sites) == nrow(counted)
)
cat(length(genes_in_table), "genes in Table S3;", nrow(counted), "counted", params$site_set, "mRNA-region sites\n")
m6a %>% group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(genes_with_site = sum(n_sites > 0), sites = sum(n_sites),
            median_len = median(region_len, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% print()
```

# 3. Target sets per contrast

```{r targets}
contrasts <- str_trim(str_split(params$contrasts, ",")[[1]])
lfc_min <- as.numeric(params$lfc_min); padj_max <- as.numeric(params$padj_max)

groups <- map_dfr(contrasts, function(ct) {
  f <- here("output", paste0("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_", ct, ".csv"))
  stopifnot("translation_categories file missing" = file.exists(f))
  tc <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
  # Direction: the columns are log2(sictrl / si3d) despite the filename, so the siRNA's own
  # target must have strongly POSITIVE rna_lfc. A negative value means the direction flipped.
  eif3d_rna <- tc$rna_lfc[tc$symbol == "EIF3D"]
  stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc should be strongly positive (knockdown)" = length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 1)
  stopifnot("gene appears twice in a contrast" = !any(duplicated(tc$gene_id_clean)))
  tc %>% filter(!is.na(te_padj)) %>%
    transmute(contrast = ct, gene_id_clean, symbol,
              group = if_else(te_lfc > lfc_min & te_padj < padj_max, "target", "rest"))
})

# The inline definition must reproduce the committed gene set where one exists.
if ("hypoxia_1hr" %in% contrasts && lfc_min == 0.5 && padj_max == 0.05) {
  gs <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  ours <- groups %>% filter(contrast == "hypoxia_1hr", group == "target") %>% pull(gene_id_clean)
  stopifnot("inline target set does not reproduce hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv" =
              setequal(ours, gs$ensembl_gene))
  cat("hypoxia 1hr target set reproduces the gene-set CSV (", length(ours), "genes )\n")
}
dplyr::count(groups, contrast, group) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n) %>% print()
```

# 4. Are targets in the table at all?

This is **not** an m6A result. A gene is in Table S3 only if it was expressed enough in HEK293T
to call a site, so this row mostly measures HEK expression. It is shown so the CDFs below can be
read knowing which fraction of each group they describe.

```{r presence}
presence <- groups %>% mutate(in_table = gene_id_clean %in% genes_in_table) %>%
  group_by(contrast) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, k) {
    tab <- table(factor(d$group, c("target", "rest")), factor(d$in_table, c(TRUE, FALSE)))
    ft <- fisher.test(tab)
    tibble(n_target = sum(tab["target", ]), target_in_table = tab["target", "TRUE"] / sum(tab["target", ]),
           n_rest = sum(tab["rest", ]), rest_in_table = tab["rest", "TRUE"] / sum(tab["rest", ]),
           odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), p = ft$p.value)
  }) %>% ungroup()
knitr::kable(presence, digits = 3)
```

# 5. CDFs: sites per region, targets vs other expressed mRNAs

Genes in Table S3 only. Each panel prints its n and a two-sided Wilcoxon p. Because most genes
have 0 or 1 site in a region, the readable number is also the **fraction with at least one site**,
tested with Fisher's exact test, in the table after the plots.

```{r plot_data}
pd <- groups %>% inner_join(m6a, by = "gene_id_clean", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region_labs[region], levels = region_labs),
         contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrasts),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("target", "rest")))
stopifnot("every grouped gene in the table should have three regions" =
            all(dplyr::count(pd, contrast, gene_id_clean)$n == 3))

group_cols <- c(target = kd_colors[["si3d"]], rest = "grey70")
group_labs <- c(target = "eIF3d promoted (si3d)", rest = "Other expressed mRNAs")

squish_for_plot <- function(d, value_col) {
  lims <- d %>% group_by(region) %>% summarise(hi = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.99, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  d %>% left_join(lims, by = "region") %>% mutate(plot_x = pmin(.data[[value_col]], hi))
}
ecdf_panel <- function(value_col, xlab, tag) {
  d <- pd %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[value_col]]))
  stats <- d %>% group_by(contrast, region) %>%
    summarise(n_t = sum(group == "target"), n_r = sum(group == "rest"),
              p = if (n_t > 0 && n_r > 0) wilcox.test(.data[[value_col]][group == "target"],
                                                      .data[[value_col]][group == "rest"])$p.value else NA_real_,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("Wilcoxon p = %s\nn = %d targets, %d other", signif(p, 2), n_t, n_r))
  write_csv(stats %>% dplyr::select(-lab),
            file.path(O, paste0("m6a_wilcoxon_", tag, "_", params$site_set, ".csv")))
  d <- squish_for_plot(d, value_col)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = plot_x, colour = group)) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
    facet_grid(contrast ~ region, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = group_cols, labels = group_labs, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = paste0(xlab, " (values above each region's 99th percentile drawn at it)"),
         y = "Cumulative fraction of genes",
         title = paste0("m6A sites (HEK293T m6A-eCLIP, ", params$site_set, " sites) by region"),
         subtitle = "Genes present in Mukhopadhyay 2023 Table S3 only; targets = TE log2(sictrl / si3d) > 0.5, padj < 0.05") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
    ggsave(here("plots", paste0("48_m6a_", tag, "_ecdf_", params$site_set, ".pdf")), p,
           width = 10, height = 2.6 * length(contrasts) + 1.2)
  p
}
```

## Sites per gene

```{r ecdf_counts, fig.width=10, fig.height=2.6 * length(str_split(params$contrasts, ",")[[1]]) + 1.2}
ecdf_panel("n_sites", "m6A sites in region", "sites")
```

## Sites per kb of region

Removes the length difference between targets and other mRNAs. Genes with no annotated region
(e.g. no 5'UTR) or mapped by symbol only have no length and are dropped from this view, so n is
smaller than above.

```{r ecdf_density, fig.width=10, fig.height=2.6 * length(str_split(params$contrasts, ",")[[1]]) + 1.2}
ecdf_panel("sites_per_kb", "m6A sites per kb of region", "density")
```

## Fraction of genes with at least one site

```{r any_site}
any_site <- pd %>% group_by(contrast, region) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, k) {
    tab <- table(factor(d$group, c("target", "rest")), factor(d$n_sites > 0, c(TRUE, FALSE)))
    ft <- fisher.test(tab)
    tibble(n_target = sum(tab["target", ]), target_with_site = tab["target", "TRUE"] / sum(tab["target", ]),
           n_rest = sum(tab["rest", ]), rest_with_site = tab["rest", "TRUE"] / sum(tab["rest", ]),
           odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), p = ft$p.value)
  }) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
knitr::kable(any_site, digits = 3)
write_csv(any_site, file.path(O, paste0("m6a_any_site_by_region_", params$site_set, ".csv")))
```
